allocation.behavior: Seed one deterministic component per split for each class, then allocate remaining components to the split with the lowest ratio-adjusted record count.

isolation.document_group_rule: All records in one group-001 document are assigned to one split.
isolation.duplicate_rule: All groups connected by any duplicate-001 exact or near cluster are assigned to one split.
isolation.cross_label_behavior: Fail without an assignment when a duplicate-analysis component contains more than one primary label.
